issues.what: Both temperature series use the same theta value, 0.78, producing identical distributions.
issues.why: The higher-temperature curve is therefore not broader, lower-peaked, or shifted to higher energy as the title, subtitle, and alt text claim. Identical distributions do not illustrate the stated increase in energy dispersal with temperature.

issues.what: The 'Lower temperature' and 'Higher temperature' series have the exact same parameter value (theta = 0.78).
issues.why: This will produce two identical curves on the chart, which directly contradicts the title, subtitle, and alt text stating that the higher-temperature distribution is broader and shifted to higher energy.
